name: Open coding models
question: Can anyone run a top coding model themselves?
metric: Months the best open-weight model trails closed models on SWE-bench Verified
solvedIf: Open-weight models match the best closed models as they are released
trendLabel: Months behind closed models, at each new best open-weight score, by release month.
caution: This only uses models Epoch AI has tested on SWE-bench Verified, and only those models.dev lists, so a new model can be missing for a while.
Open-weight means anyone can download the model, not that it is cheap to run. The largest open models need serious hardware.
rule: Catching up when the newest open-weight best trails closed models by fewer months than the first one did.
